title: Wiki Nebula
summary: Live 3D art driven by Wikipedia's real-time edit stream: every edit bursts glowing particles out of a rippling orb, colored by who made it and how big it was. The agent piped the public stream straight into a three.js panel, so the edits never passed through the model.
prompt: use tapet to create a free form 3d art in real time , connect it to something in the internet

media.alt: A wireframe orb ripples as live Wikipedia edits burst out of it as glowing particles that swirl into an orbiting cloud
A wireframe orb in the middle of a cloud of glowing particles, with the edit rate (13.8 edits/sec) and the latest edited page titles in the corner
